📸Content Concept

⭐ MUST HOOK → dry, rough heels or elbows up close. The weather changed and your skin shows it

Content flow : rough heel close-up → "the weather changed and my skin is so dry" → "6 places to use your stick balm" → 6 places, one by one, name on screen → the glow → hold the stick up

🎬How to Film It
Where to use it one stick → 6 places
Hook
"The weather changed and my heels look like this."Open on your dry, rough heel (or elbow) up close. Bare skin, no filter.
Problem
"My elbows, my knees, everything is dry."Show one more dry spot up close. Then hold the stick up and put "6 places to use your stick balm" on screen.
Solution
"So it goes everywhere."Go through the places in order, one cut each, name on screen:
  1. Heels and elbows first, the spots you opened on
  2. Knees and shins, for dry, tight legs
  3. Chest & collarbone, for a glow
  4. Your driest spot, wherever it's worst for you
Proof
"Look at that."Run your finger over a spot you just did. Turn it to the light so the glow shows.
Close
⭐ Hold the stick up. "One stick for every dry spot. It lives in my bag now."

Open on a dry body spot, one cut per place with the name on screen, end on the stick in your hand

✅Filming Rules
  • Open on a dry, rough heel or elbow, not your face.
  • Put "6 places to use your stick balm" on screen.
  • Body only. Skip the face this time.
  • Name each spot on screen as you go.
  • Twist it up and swipe, close to the camera.
  • Bare skin, no filter.
  • Hands in frame for every spot.
  • 20 seconds or longer.
  • Post the last week of October.
